WebBlock blocks websites on your Android phone – in Chrome, Firefox, Samsung Internet, Brave, Edge, Opera, DuckDuckGo and other browsers.

### Features
- Block whole sites, single sections (reddit.com/r/all) or keywords
- Closes the browser tab of a blocked site
- Schedule with times and days of the week
- Alpha mode: locks your settings until a chosen date and time
- Block list protected by fingerprint or PIN
- Checks new sites and suggests fixes for typos
- No ads, no tracking, no account

### Install
1. Download the `.apk` file below and open it.
2. If Play Protect blocks it: Play Store › Play Protect › ⚙ › turn off scanning, install, then turn it back on.
3. Android 13 and newer: Settings › Apps › WebBlock › ⋮ › "Allow restricted settings".
4. Open WebBlock and tap "Enable now" to turn on the accessibility service.
